壱 — 01
The Dojo

A small dojo.
A serious art.

Most gyms sell you a membership. A dojo gives you a skill — one that stays with you long after the session ends.

Gracie Jiu-Jitsu is built on leverage, timing and technique — not size or strength. That is why it works for everyone: kids finding their confidence, adults getting fit, and anyone who wants to know they can look after themselves.

At Gracie Gym Tauranga you train on the mats at 26 Alach St, in a club where beginners are welcomed properly and nobody is left to figure it out alone.

01

Technique before strength

Learn the move properly first. Power comes later — and it comes naturally.

02

Train with respect

Partners look after each other. You tap, you learn, you go again.

03

Progress you can feel

Every class leaves you a little sharper, a little fitter, a little more confident.
